correctness.rationale: For any N, induced bipartite graph with vertices {0,...,N} on each side is a forest with <=2N+1 edges. Each support d<=N yields d+1 distinct edges, implying weighted prefix sum<=2N+1. With N=d_n, a_n=d_n+1>=1+sum_{j<n} a_j, inductively >=2^n. Thus positions d_n>=2^n-1 and prefix occupancy <=1+floor log2(N+1). D*={2^n-1} satisfies strict d_{n+1}>2d_n, hence source Proposition 7.12 v2 proves forest; exact saturation all N. Independently checked exact finite edge counts N=0,1,3,7,15,31, not used as infinite proof.
